## ICollateralParams interface

Plain collateral params input accepted by [MarketParams](./midnight-sdk.marketparams.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ICollateralParams
```

## Example


```ts
import type { ICollateralParams } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const params: ICollateralParams = {
  token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
  lltv: 770000000000000000n,
  liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
  oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000002",
```
